svg.text: F03-7 Filled L2 checklist MEC-L2-CRAH-B2-DH3-14 rev 0 (example)
CRAH B2-DH3-CRAH-14 · template T-MEC-L2-CRAH rev C · submittal SUB-B2-M-0331 rev 2 · 11 items · 10 yes, 1 no (label) · issue ISS-B2-1301 category C
• The power cable insulation resistance of 2,450 MΩ at 1,000 V DC meets the 100 MΩ minimum.
• Item 11 (label) is answered "no" and is linked to issue ISS-B2-1301; the category C issue does not block the L2 gate.
